chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Fadalah from Safwan from al-Ala' from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of the Imams (peace be upon them both) who said:
It is not valid except from one person at Mina.

key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, a sacred site near Mecca where key Hajj rituals take place

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for the validity of sacrifice at Mina according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This concise hadith from the Tahdhib al-Ahkam clarifies the validity of the sacrificial rite (dhabh) during Hajj, emphasizing that it is legally permissible when performed by a single individual at Mina. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling underscores the flexibility of the Hajj sacrifice, distinguishing it from stricter communal requirements found in other schools, and highlights Mina as the primary locus for this ritual act.
